name: trilly_pregrad_v4
what_changed: Added leak-safe WALLET-REPUTATION features to the v3.2 3-label blend: outcome-weighted reputation of a token's early/big buyers (mean prior realized-$ track record, strict walk-forward) + STEP5 recurrence
selection_recipe: per label: avg 5 seed boosters; percentile-rank the label-score; blend = mean of 3 percentile-ranks; pick top-K/day by blend.
boosters: boosters/<label>_s<seed>.txt (3 labels x 5 seeds = 15 LightGBM models, full-pop fit)

depth_menu.note: conservative; use during initial observe soak
recommended (lab 30/day validated, rank_cut from reference_dist.json serve field)
higher depth; calibrate on live stream

live_compute: maintain a wallet bank (per-wallet running realized-$ outcomes of its prior early/big graduate picks, updated as tokens resolve). On a new graduation: pull pre-grad Helius tape, identify first-10-by-time + top-10-by-size buyers, look up each in the bank, aggregate -> REP/ARCH features. All inputs are <= graduation instant -> leak-safe.
provenance: OOT 5-fold chrono walk-forward on ~23.9k enterable graduates; REP significance z=5.12 @30/day (N=30 placebo null, p<0.001); seed-robust; survives regime control.
